title: Claude Fable 5でストーリーボード向けのプロンプトジェネレーターを作り、フォーム入力だけでGPT Images…
content:
Claude Fable 5でストーリーボード向けのプロンプトジェネレーターを作り、フォーム入力だけでGPT Images 2.0用プロンプトを自動生成してストーリーボードを作る  
生成したストーリーボードを参照してSeedance 2.0で動画化する

author.name: 小田芳揮｜映像演出・撮影・編集

en.content:
---
Create a prompt generator for storyboards in Claude Fable 5, automatically generating prompts for GPT Images 2.0 with just form input to create storyboards.  
Refer to the generated storyboard to create a video with Seedance 2.0.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
I tried creating a prompt generator for storyboards in Claude Fable 5😃

By simply entering the necessary information into the form, it automatically generates prompts for GPT Images 2.0.  
If you turn it into a Skill, you can call it up anytime, making it quite convenient✨

Here is what was videoized using Seedance 2.0 by referring to the generated storyboard👇

This time, I will introduce

✅ The process of creating the storyboard generator  
✅ The prompts actually used  
✅ The prompts generated by the storyboard generator  

and more.
---
